title: Injustice at the Intersections: Race, Gender, Class, and Criminal Justice
description: Injustice at the Intersections is the first U.S.-based Open Textbook about race, gender, class, and criminal justice. While traditional textbooks are often expensive and require continuous publication of new editions to keep up with changing legislation and events, we wrote this Open Textbook under a CC BY-NC-SA license, meaning that instructors may revise, update, and change content as needed for changing events and different learning outcomes. We also plan to regularly update this Open Textbook and will always keep it free, as we believe that knowledge is the first step towards justice.
authors: Indigo Koslicki - Author / Andrew C. Gray - Author
publisher: Indigo Koslicki and Andrew C. Gray
